facts.text: Bluefield State was founded in 1895 as Bluefield Colored Institute to serve racially segregated public schools in coal camps.

sources.title: General University Information - Bluefield State University
sources.quote: To serve the racially segregated public schools in the coal camps, progressive citizens of both races worked together to establish Bluefield Colored Institute, a “high graded school for Negroes,” in 1895.
